answer: Put Licensed dairy herd manager log with dairy board confirmation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. An honest agent spends 16 minutes once; the operator of 454 fakes spends 7264 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the willow of the check, count the ivory of the cost, and read the saffron of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
